handback.summary: Seeding test records now stops background git on the remote and keeps its scratch copy in each test's own folder.

criteria.ask: `tests/record_seed.py`: `seed` turns off gc and maintenance in the remote, clones beside it, removes the clone; pinned by `tests/test_record_seed.py`.

handback.evidence: 20 parallel runs of `test_blocked_worker.py` with `-n 4`: all 8 passed each time.

raises.label: Background git in tests
raises.text: The test machine's pushes still start background git maintenance on its remote; the turned-off settings never reach that side.
raises.evidence: `tests/test_start.py` `git_env`; a traced local push still starts `git maintenance run --auto --detach`.
